source: boss guides, read by hand: Maxroll, Mobalytics, PoE2 Wiki
note: Tells are in our own words from the named sources, each on the hit it belongs to. A hit with no source for its tell has none.

hits.name: Falling Flame Seed
hits.tell: Flame seeds drop, each with a ring of fire around it. Everything outside the ring blows up a moment later: get inside. Before a chain of seeds he fires one flare up per seed.

hits.name: Bullet Hell
hits.tell: Slow fire orbs float out and spray small fireballs in every direction. Run past them to the far side of the arena.

hits.name: Combo Slam
hits.tell: Flies up and cuts a line of fire across the arena, then slams down three times, each one wider.

hits.name: Sword Slam
hits.tell: Leaps into the air, often with a voice line, then drives the sword down. Keep moving once he jumps; a roll on the way down is late.

hits.name: Slam
hits.tell: Second phase: channels and draws a circle on the ground, then teleports into it and slams. Leave the circle as soon as it shows.

hits.name: Teleport Slam
hits.tell: Last phase: digs into the ground, then drops out of the sky onto an area. Since 0.3.0b it cannot be avoided.

hits.name: Arena-wide Cleave
hits.tell: A wide strip of the arena is marked and swept by wind. A cold wave runs the way the wind and its neck point, then comes back the other way.

hits.name: Xoph Sun Orb
hits.tell: An orange fire orb forms over his head and is thrown at the ground in front of him. Walk away from where he faces.

hits.name: Finger Gun
hits.tell: Raises a hand like a pistol, with a sound cue, then flicks out a slow wave of air. Circle him, roll it, or break line of sight behind a wall. Frost Wall does not block it.

hits.name: Clap Cleave
hits.tell: Dives underground and chases you, then comes up and claps, slicing the ground to both sides. Run wide circles at the arena edge until the slices are done.

hits.name: Hand Slam
hits.tell: A giant hand hovers after you. A pink and purple hand shape marks the ground, then it slams. Roll to its side, not past the fingers; its shadow shows where it is. His hardest hit.
